name: wispcrew
description: WispCrew — a free, open-source desktop AI agent. Bring your own LLM (DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint).
author: WispCrew contributors

scripts.//build: Packages are built in dependency order. `--workspaces` runs them in an arbitrary order, which breaks a fresh clone: everything imports @wispcrew/shared, and TypeScript resolves it to dist/ that does not exist yet.
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @wispcrew/shared && npm run build --workspace @wispcrew/tools && npm run build --workspace @wispcrew/llm && npm run build --workspace @wispcrew/mcp && npm run build --workspace @wispcrew/core && npm run build --workspace @wispcrew/runtime
scripts.//build-daemon: The daemon is built alongside the desktop app, not on demand. Tests spawn `apps/daemon/dist/cli.js` as a real process, and on a fresh clone that file did not exist — the spawn failed silently and the suite reported a timeout instead of a missing build.
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @wispcrew/daemon && npm run build --workspace @wispcrew/desktop
scripts.//typecheck: Typechecking also needs the declaration files, so build the packages first. On a fresh clone this is the difference between a clean run and a wall of TS2307.
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
